sloka: प्राप्तकालं कृतं तेन पौलस्त्येन महात्मना।यत एव भयं दृष्टं तमेव शरणं गतः ।। ६.९५.४० ।।
transliteration: prāptakālaṁ kṛtaṁ tena paulastyena mahātmanā।yata eva bhayaṁ dṛṣṭaṁ tameva śaraṇaṁ gataḥ ।। 6.95.40 ।।

translations.english: "Indeed, there is no protection for us here to stay, as we are like the female elephants in the forest covered by huge wildfire."
